summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS/ECS container credentials to attacker-controlled ngrok endpoint
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that runs on npm install. The script uses node to fetch the ECS/EKS container credentials endpoint at the link-local metadata address 169.254.170.2 (/v3/ IAM task role credentials) and pipes the response body via curl -X POST to the hardcoded remote URL https://mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev. This harvests IAM role credentials from the installer's build/CI environment and sends them to an attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel. Trigger is automatic on install — no user interaction required.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
